intro: The Zurina bedside table perfectly complements your bed with its compact design and elegant maple finish. Designed for functionality and style, it adds charm and practicality to your bedroom.

features.title: Dual storage for daily needs
features.text: Features a drawer and hinged door compartment, offering convenient storage for bedside essentials and keeping your space clutter-free.

features.title: Sturdy build with quality materials
features.text: Crafted from 18mm prelaminated particleboard with decorative HDF trims, it ensures durability and long-lasting appeal.

features.title: Compact design for small spaces
features.text: A space-efficient structure that fits snugly by your bed while providing ample storage for personal items.

features.title: Elegant Finish
features.text: The warm maple finish adds a touch of sophistication, blending beautifully with traditional and modern bedroom interiors.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
